Since your manager is watching this one, here's what the change does outside the code. Any client calling `GET /parcels` without a page size will now get up to twice as many results in each response, with fewer pages to go through. Code that loops over pages until it gets an empty one keeps working. Code that assumes 50 per page does not, for example code that works out page counts or offsets from 50. Response size and query time for those calls will also roughly double at the top end.

If you know of any internal consumers or dashboards that call this endpoint without a page size, those are worth a quick look before it ships.
